title: "Flow and its fluctuations at ATLAS-- a perspective in large systems" by Prof. Jia Jiangyong
description:
Prof. Jia Jiangyong (Stonybrook University)

The goal of this lecture is to expose the audience to aspects of flow analysis in ATLAS.  After a short introduction I will give a tour of various flow observables. I then discuss several results, in increasing level of complexity,  about why, how and what was measured. I will end my talk with a summary and outlook.
